query_examples.question: How many catalog items does each line have?
query_examples.cypher:
MATCH (i:Item) WHERE i.run IS NULL
RETURN i.line AS line, count(i) AS items ORDER BY items DESC

query_examples.question: What is a linen blazer worn with, and why?
query_examples.cypher:
MATCH (i:Item) WHERE toLower(i.name) CONTAINS 'linen blazer'
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[r:LAYERED_WITH]-(p:Item)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:IS_CATEGORY]->(c:Category)-[pw:PAIRS_WITH]-(pc:Category)
RETURN i.name AS item, collect(DISTINCT {item: p.name, why: r.rationale}) AS layered_with,
       collect(DISTINCT {category: pc.short, why: pw.rationale}) AS category_rules

query_examples.question: Which articles say something about trench coats?
query_examples.cypher:
MATCH (a:Article)-[:HAS_STATEMENT]->(s:Statement)-[:ILLUSTRATES]->(i:Item)-[:IS_CATEGORY]->(c:Category)
WHERE c.short = 'coat' AND toLower(i.name) CONTAINS 'trench'
RETURN a.title AS article, substring(s.text, 0, 200) AS statement, collect(DISTINCT i.name) AS items LIMIT 50

query_examples.question: Which category rules are meant for evening?
query_examples.cypher:
MATCH (a:Category)-[r:PAIRS_WITH]->(b:Category)
WHERE r.occasion IN ['evening', 'any']
RETURN a.short AS category, b.short AS pairs_with, r.occasion AS occasion, r.rationale AS why
ORDER BY occasion, category
